theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_vdb_open_thickening_exhaustion
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclidean N)), IsOpen U → ∃ (W : ℕ → Set (Euclidean N)) (r : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ p, 0 < r p) ∧ (∀ p, IsRelCompactOpenIn (thickening (r p) (W p)) U) ∧ U ⊆ ⋃ p, W p
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
